description: Five-class Phase-2 numeric fixture manifest plus one adapter-evidence entry (see 'adapter_fixtures', which is outside 'fixtures' so the five-class numeric gate is unchanged). Paths are relative to the repository root. 'ready' fixtures have a complete parameter file and a stored independent OpenMM reference; 'blocked' fixtures state the exact missing input. Every committed file is pinned by SHA-256 and byte count in its entry's 'files' object; a declared path that is absent from disk is recorded as 'status_of_file: missing' rather than hashed. The membrane parameters are generated into an external cache and are not committed, so only its source structure is pinned. This description is prose: the hashes, not this text, are the integrity gate. 'adapter_fixtures' entries carry CHARMM structural-mapping evidence only and are not part of the five-class numeric comparison.

fixtures.force_field: AMBER prmtop from the OpenMM test suite (Zn2+ ion in TIP3P water; the file is named Mg_water but the atom is ZN); includes AMBER 1-6-4 LENNARD_JONES_CCOEF, implemented as a separate -C/r^4 factor
AMBER prmtop from the OpenMM test suite (18-residue solvated protein, K+/Cl-, TIP3P)
AMBER prmtop from the OpenMM test suite (DNA duplex, no periodic box)
OpenMM amber19/lipid21.xml + amber19/tip3p.xml, exported to AMBER prmtop by ParmEd (DPPC bilayer + water)

AMBER ff14SB protein + OpenForceField-parameterized catechol ligand (residue UNL) from PDB 1XEP (T4 lysozyme L99A/M102Q); solute-only prmtop/coordinates derived from the MIT-licensed ljmartin/mmpbsa_from_openmm preparation (commit 48664084); no box, NoCutoff reference

adapter_fixtures.class: CHARMM PSF/PRM adapter evidence (not one of the five classes)
adapter_fixtures.status: ready (structural mapping only; no independent CHARMM energy oracle exists)
adapter_fixtures.limitation: CHARMM has structural-only reference evidence (atom/term mapping + zero-force consistency at the stored coordinates), so it is not part of the five-class numeric gate; no independent CHARMM energy oracle exists in this checkout.
